verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack documents a natural-language command interface for Treasury, such as an in-dashboard assistant or a conversational operation mode. Treasury is described only through the Dashboard, the mobile app, APIs and embedded components. The Stripe-wide MCP server (probe-4) and llms.txt (probe-1) belong to separate agent-integration and docs stories, and neither is shown to let users operate Treasury via natural language, so they earn no credit here.
